posts.author: Gabriel18075
posts.body:
I want to make a 3D Dungeon Crawler game, and I found these two plugins that can be used for this type of game.
These are MZ3D and PNDK 3D:
MZ3D - 3D Rendering Plugin for RPG Maker MZ by Cutievirus
Create 3D games with RPG Maker MZ
cutievirus.itch.io
3D Plugin for RPG Maker MZ and MV (PNDK 3D) by PANDAKO
This plugin allows you to create 3D games with RPG Maker MZ and MV.
pandako.itch.io
Can anyone with experience with these plugins tell me which Is the better one?

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
MZ3D is the one everyone that makes that kind of game uses. The pandako one might be good but I haven't seen anyone use it.
There's also the "use another engine that's better suited for 3D" option
